fdic_ownership_categories.rules_and_requirements: Applies to deposit accounts owned by one person individually with no named beneficiaries (POD/ITF). All single accounts held by the same person at the same bank charter are aggregated.

fdic_ownership_categories.ownership_category: Joint Accounts (Two or more co-owners with no beneficiaries)
fdic_ownership_categories.rules_and_requirements: Each co-owner must be a natural person, have equal withdrawal rights, and have personally signed the account signature card (or completed electronic authentication). Insured separately from each owner's Single Account.

fdic_ownership_categories.ownership_category: Trust Accounts (POD/ITF Informal Revocable, Formal Revocable & Irrevocable Trusts)
fdic_ownership_categories.coverage_limit: $250,000 per owner per unique eligible beneficiary (up to 5 beneficiaries = $1,250,000 per owner)
fdic_ownership_categories.rules_and_requirements: Effective April 1, 2024, FDIC unified informal POD/ITF, formal revocable, and irrevocable trusts under a single formula: # of Owners × # of Unique Eligible Beneficiaries × $250,000, capped at $1,250,000 per owner per bank charter. Simply adding Payable-on-Death (POD) beneficiaries to a savings account shifts it from Single ($250k) to Trust coverage (up to $1.25M).

fdic_ownership_categories.ownership_category: Certain Retirement Accounts (IRAs: Traditional, Roth, SEP, SIMPLE)
fdic_ownership_categories.rules_and_requirements: All self-directed retirement deposit accounts (e.g., IRA Online Savings and IRA CDs) owned by the same person at the same FDIC-insured bank are added together and insured up to $250,000 total.
